title: Do Not Spare Yourself: An Antidote to Feeling Like You Are Waiting to Start Living
author: Maria Popova
summary: The only thing more dangerous than wanting to save another person — a dangerous desire too often mistaken for love — is wanting to save yourself, to spare yourself the disappointment and heartbreak and loss inseparable from being a creature with hopes and longings constantly colliding with reality, with the indifference of time and chance, with the opposing hopes and longings of others.
